name: battery at 0 is sent, not left out
text: state { seq: 1 power { battery: 0 charging: false } }

name: hello of a phone
text: hello { min_version: 2 max_version: 2 features: 254 role: ROLE_PHONE install_id: "0123456789abcdef" app_version: "1.0.0" device_model: "Pixel 8" state_mark { epoch: 7 seq: 41 } text_cursor: 12 call_cursor: 3 }

name: hello that resumes
text: hello { min_version: 2 max_version: 2 role: ROLE_PHONE install_id: "0123456789abcdef" resume { session_id: 9 received: 17 } }

name: welcome
text: welcome { version: 2 features: 126 session_id: 9 epoch: 7 audio_psm: 193 host { app_version: "1.0.0" device_model: "Redmi Note 12" hotspot { bands: HOTSPOT_BAND_2G bands: HOTSPOT_BAND_5G securities: HOTSPOT_SECURITY_WPA2 max_clients: 10 call_pause: true } max_blocked_numbers: 50 max_mac_peers: 4 } }

name: dial on the default line
text: request { id: 4 age_ms: 120 dial { number: "+905551112233" client_ref: "ref-ref-ref-ref-" } }

name: the call started
text: reply { id: 4 code: CODE_OK dial { call: 88 } }

name: turn roaming off on line 1
text: request { id: 8 set_line { line: 1 roaming: false } }

name: keypad tones
text: request { id: 9 send_tones { call: 88 digits: "1234#" tone_ms: 120 gap_ms: 80 } }

name: a text came in
text: event { seq: 13 text_in { from: "+905551112233" body: "Kodunuz 482913 ş€" line: 1 at_ms: 1794466000000 } }

name: a text was delivered
text: event { seq: 14 text_status { text: 14 client_ref: "ref-ref-ref-ref-" phase: TEXT_PHASE_DELIVERED } }

name: an incoming call rings
text: event { seq: 4 call { call: 89 phase: CALL_PHASE_RINGING incoming: true number: "+905551112233" line: 0 phase_since_ms: 1794466001000 } }
